sections.theory:
The Trumpet of Action — Majeed Amjad

Stanza 1

Come — how long shall we complain of the ill-luck of fate? how long mourn the failure of our efforts?

How long shall we lament the tyranny of the old sky? how long complain of the unkindness of the days?

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 2

Today the garden of the homeland is ruined by autumn; today the bedchamber of the homeland is deprived of radiance;

the school of the homeland is a centre of wailing and lament — it is time to cure the pain of the unsuccessful heart.

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 3

Come, let us people the ruined settlement again; come, let us set free again the fettered souls;

come, let us follow somewhat the way of Farhad — this is not the condition of loyalty, to sit and rest.

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 4

A kind of tumult is raging in the world today; today brother thirsts for the blood of his own brother;

today loyalty is not found in the world even by searching — come, let us make this precious commodity common again.

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 5

Let us not fear the cup of Jamshed, nor the glory of Kay; let us not fear the majesty of Rome or the might of Rayy;

we are young, so let us fear nothing here; we are young, so let us have no apprehension of sorrows.

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 6

Let us break the thread of deceit and hypocrisy — yes, break it; let us smash the begging-bowl of greed and lust — yes, smash it;

let us give up this strange manner of ours — yes, give it up; come, let us do some work — work, work!

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

(Roz-e-Rafta)

د وطن ځوانانو! راشئ چې کوم کار وکړو.

بند 6

د چل او ریا تار وشلوو، هو وشلوو؛ د حرص او هوس کاسه ماته کړو، هو ماته کړو؛

دا خپل عجیب انداز پرېږدو، هو پرېږدو؛ راشئ چې یو څه کار وکړو — کار وکړو، کار وکړو!

د وطن ځوانانو! راشئ چې کوم کار وکړو.

(روز رفته)
sections.content:
The Trumpet of Action — Majeed Amjad

Stanza 1

Come — how long shall we complain of the ill-luck of fate? how long mourn the failure of our efforts?

How long shall we lament the tyranny of the old sky? how long complain of the unkindness of the days?

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 2

Today the garden of the homeland is ruined by autumn; today the bedchamber of the homeland is deprived of radiance;

the school of the homeland is a centre of wailing and lament — it is time to cure the pain of the unsuccessful heart.

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 3

Come, let us people the ruined settlement again; come, let us set free again the fettered souls;

come, let us follow somewhat the way of Farhad — this is not the condition of loyalty, to sit and rest.

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 4

A kind of tumult is raging in the world today; today brother thirsts for the blood of his own brother;

today loyalty is not found in the world even by searching — come, let us make this precious commodity common again.

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 5

Let us not fear the cup of Jamshed, nor the glory of Kay; let us not fear the majesty of Rome or the might of Rayy;

we are young, so let us fear nothing here; we are young, so let us have no apprehension of sorrows.

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

Stanza 6

Let us break the thread of deceit and hypocrisy — yes, break it; let us smash the begging-bowl of greed and lust — yes, smash it;

let us give up this strange manner of ours — yes, give it up; come, let us do some work — work, work!

Youth of the homeland! Come, let us do some work.

(Roz-e-Rafta)

sections.heading: متنِ نظم
sections.text:
نفیرِ عمل — مجید امجدؔ

بند ۱

آؤ کب تک گلۂ شومیِ تقدیر کریں ۔ کب تلک ماتمِ ناکامیِ تدبیر کریں

کب تلک شیونِ جورِ فلکِ پیر کریں ۔ کب تلک شکوۂ بے مہریِ ایام کریں

نوجوانانِ وطن! آؤ کوئی کام کریں

بند ۲

آج بربادِ خزاں ہے چمنستانِ وطن ۔ آج محرومِ تجلّی ہے شبستانِ وطن

مرکزِ نالہ و شیون ہے دبستانِ وطن ۔ وقت ہے چارۂ دردِ دلِ ناکام کریں

نوجوانانِ وطن! آؤ کوئی کام کریں

بند ۳

آؤ اُجڑی ہوئی بستی کو پھر آباد کریں ۔ آؤ جکڑی ہوئی روحوں کو پھر آزاد کریں

آؤ کچھ پیرویِ مسلکِ فرہاد کریں ۔ یہ نہیں شرطِ وفا بیٹھ کے آرام کریں

نوجوانانِ وطن! آؤ کوئی کام کریں

بند ۴

ایک ہنگامہ سا ہے آج جہاں میں برپا ۔ آج بھائی ہے سگے بھائی کے خوں کا پیاسا

آج ڈھونڈے سے نہیں ملتی زمانے میں وفا ۔ آؤ اس جنسِ گراں مایہ کو پھر عام کریں

نوجوانانِ وطن! آؤ کوئی کام کریں

بند ۵

جامِ جم سے نہ ڈریں شوکتِ کَے سے نہ ڈریں ۔ حشمتِ رُوم اور صولتِ رَے سے نہ ڈریں

ہم جواں ہیں تو یہاں کی کسی شے سے نہ ڈریں ۔ ہم جواں ہیں تو نہ کچھ خدشۂ آلام کریں

نوجوانانِ وطن! آؤ کوئی کام کریں

بند ۶

رشتۂ مکر و ریا توڑ بھی دیں، توڑ بھی دیں ۔ کاسۂ حرص و ہوا پھوڑ بھی دیں، پھوڑ بھی دیں

اپنی یہ طُرفہ ادا چھوڑ بھی دیں، چھوڑ بھی دیں ۔ آؤ کچھ کام کریں، کام کریں، کام کریں

نوجوانانِ وطن! آؤ کوئی کام کریں

(روزِ رفتہ)
sections.sourceNote: Each stanza is printed as two couplets set as side-by-side half-lines, followed by the refrain; here each pair of half-lines is joined with “ ۔ ” on one line.

issues.description: Source line printed “روزِ رفتہ”, while the author note (p.211) lists the collection as “شبِ رفتہ” — retained as printed. Majeed Amjad (d.1974) is public domain; transcribed in full.
